description_en: Analyzes the color information of an input image and returns color values in RGB and HEX formats along with their corresponding proportions
description_zh: 对输入图的颜色信息进行分析，给出颜色值（RGB形式和HEX格式）与对应的占比信息
name: RecognizeImageColor

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length
parameters.help_zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The expected number of colors in the output palette. Valid values: 1 to 7
parameters.help_zh: 期望的色板输出数量，范围 \[1, 7\]
parameters.name: color_count
